description: This file defines the BlockContentController class for managing content block routes in Drupal, including creating blocks and generating page titles.

classes.name: BlockContentController
classes.description: Controller class for handling custom block routes, including creating blocks and rendering forms.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the controller with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes storage and theme handler dependencies.

methods.name: addForm
methods.description: Creates a new content block and returns its form, optionally setting the theme based on request parameters.

methods.name: getAddFormTitle
methods.description: Returns the page title for adding a new content block of a specific type.
